description.narrative: The General Conference approved, at its 43rd session, a one-off appropriation of $31 million to supplement the regular budget for the 2026–2027 financial period (43 C/5). The 224th Executive Board approved an additional allocation to provide direct support for field offices programme management and support services. This allocation will be allocated to address immediate priority requirements for operations, connectivity, and security, as well as to reinforce HQ/Field coordination and consultations mechanisms, information sharing, provisions for unexpected support to field offices in crisis contexts.
